g.text: Compute capacity of AI data centers

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 10.2px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: What it shows: total installed compute capacity across the 77 AI data centers Epoch tracks, reproduced from Epoch's

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 10.2px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: published dataset. Observed data only — every future-dated milestone in the source has been excluded, so the series ends

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 10.2px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: at the snapshot rather than running to 2030.

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 8.6px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, AI Data Centers (CC-BY) — https://epoch.ai/data/ai-data-centers

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 8.6px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows Epoch AI's published data centers documentation

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Note: Observed data only. Epoch's files carry no observed/projected flag, so the boundary is the date: 72 of 430 timeline records are dated

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: after the 2026-08-06 snapshot and are excluded as schedules, leaving 358 observed records. Including them would carry the line to

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: 65.3M by 2030, which is a plan, not a measurement. The step-sum at the snapshot reproduces Epoch's own published current total

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: exactly. Compute is derived by Epoch from IT power and the chip mix judged most likely to be installed, except where a site's chips

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: are actually reported. It is a modelled quantity, not a hardware inventory. Coverage is about 27% of AI compute delivered globally

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: and is strongest for the largest sites, so this is a floor on the world total. Values before 2023-01-01 are included in the level but

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start
